latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of community-operations skill, version 1.0.0.
- Enables the design and implementation of automatic community commenting workflows based on existing site content.
- Supports content extraction, context-aware comment generation, account rotation, scheduling, and logging.
- Includes optional moderation handoff before or after comment submission, but does not own moderation policy.
- Provides structured guidance and templates for extracting content, generating varied comment styles, and enforcing anti-duplication and frequency controls.
- Lays groundwork for future expansion into automatic posting and campaign scheduling.
